# Game Idea: Starship Escape

A top‑down HTML canvas game where the player pilots a small starship through an asteroid field, collecting fuel cells while dodging moving asteroids. The ship has limited shield energy; colliding with an asteroid or running out of fuel ends the game.

9:   const height = canvas.height;
10: 
11:   // --- Game state -------------------------------------------------
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height - 40,
15:     radius: 10,
16:     speed: 3,
17:     shield: 100,
18:     fuel: 100,
19:     dx: 0,
20:     dy: 0,
21:   };
22:   // starfield background
23:   const stars = [];
24:   for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
25:     stars.push({
26:       x: Math.random() * width,
27:       y: Math.random() * height,
28:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
29:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.3,
30:     });
31:   }
32: 
33:   const asteroids = [];
34:   const fuels = [];
35:   let score = 0;
36:   let gameOver = false;
37: 
38:   // --- Helper functions -------------------------------------------
39:   function rand(min, max) {
40:     return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
41:   }
42: 
43:   function spawnAsteroid() {
44:     const size = rand(8, 20);
45:     asteroids.push({
46:       x: rand(size, width - size),
47:       y: -size,
48:       radius: size,
49:       speed: rand(1, 3),
50:     });
51:   }
52: 
53:   function spawnFuel() {
54:     const size = 8;
55:     fuels.push({
56:       x: rand(size, width - size),
57:       y: -size,
58:       radius: size,
59:       speed: 1.5,
60:     });
61:   }
62: 
63:   function circleCollides(a, b) {
64:     const dx = a.x - b.x;
65:     const dy = a.y - b.y;
66:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
67:     return dist < a.radius + b.radius;
68:   }

70:   // --- Input ------------------------------------------------------
71:   const keys = {};
72:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
73:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
74: 
75:   // Load sound effects (place files in a "sounds" folder next to this script)
76:   const sound = {
77:     thrust: new Audio('sounds/thrust.mp3'),
78:     crash: new Audio('sounds/crash.mp3'),
79:     fuel: new Audio('sounds/fuel.mp3'),
80:     gameover: new Audio('sounds/gameover.mp3'),
81:   };
82:   // Simple volume tweaks
83:   sound.thrust.volume = 0.3;
84:   sound.crash.volume = 0.5;
85:   sound.fuel.volume = 0.4;
86:   sound.gameover.volume = 0.6;
87: 
88:   function playSound(name) {
89:     const s = sound[name];
90:     if (s) {
91:       s.currentTime = 0;
92:       s.play().catch(() => {});
93:     }
94:   }
95: 
96:   function handleInput() {
97:     const prevDx = ship.dx;
98:     const prevDy = ship.dy;
99:     ship.dx = 0;
100:     ship.dy = 0;
101:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
102:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.dx = ship.speed;
103:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
104:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.dy = ship.speed;
105:     // Play thrust sound when any movement key is pressed
106:     if ((ship.dx !== 0 || ship.dy !== 0) && (prevDx === 0 && prevDy === 0)) {
107:       playSound('thrust');
108:     }
109:   }
110: 
111:   // --- Game loop ---------------------------------------------------
112:   let frame = 0;
113:   function update() {
114:     if (gameOver) return;
115:     frame++;
116:     handleInput();
117:     // move ship
118:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(width - ship.radius, ship.x + ship.dx));
119:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(height - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.dy));
120:     // fuel consumption
121:     ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.02);
122:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) ship.shield = 0;
123: 
124:     // spawn obstacles
125:     if (frame % 60 === 0) spawnAsteroid(); // roughly 1 per second
126:     if (frame % 300 === 0) spawnFuel(); // every 5 seconds
127: 
128:     // update asteroids
129:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
130:       const a = asteroids[i];
131:       a.y += a.speed;

142:     }
